name: Federal Register 88 FR 73458 - Oct 2023 advanced computing export controls (Country Group D:5 / Macau, RS controls)

notes: US Bureau of Industry and Security (BIS) 2023 export controls on advanced computing and semiconductor manufacturing. Federal Register document 2023-23055, published 2023-10-25.
